default_dir_note: lentimpra.DEFAULT_DIR is D:/dna_decode_cache/mpra_human and does NOT exist on this host; the data is on C: at data/mpra_human, so the directory must be passed explicitly or the loader reports absent data

fold_contract.held_out_role: WORKING_HELD_OUT (fold 9) ONLY -- the decision-grade set. Fold 10 stays FINAL_ONLY and is not read here.
fold_contract.why: publishers' own 10-fold assignment; the oracle never sees the generator's folds, which makes it an INDEPENDENT judge

checked: positional refuses a non-dividing bin count
precondition.why: values are hand-derived from the definitions, so this is a CORRECTNESS check and not a record of current output. It RAISES rather than returning a verdict, because a floor that never computes is not a failing floor -- it is no floor.
precondition.limit: it pins the FEATURE pipeline, not the fitted ridge: a changed linear-algebra backend that still builds identical features would pass this and must be caught by the end-to-end value pin in the test suite.

gate.why: a weak oracle cannot validate a generator's designs; its verdict would be uninterpretable the way a sub-chance eval set was on the E. coli arm

verdict_detail: Every cell clears the pre-registered gate on the primary geometry, so the oracle is a competent judge and a generator design question is interpretable against it. This does NOT show a generator can design to it -- only that the judge works.

WTC11_BEST_ARM_IS_KMER4_NOT_KMER6.the_trap: HepG2 and K562 deploy the 6-mer arm. On WTC11 the 6-mer arm scores 0.2240 against the 4-mer's 0.3607, so defaulting to 'the oracle is kmer6' uses a 61 percent relatively worse judge on this cell.
WTC11_BEST_ARM_IS_KMER4_NOT_KMER6.cause_MEASURED_not_inferred: a sample-size artifact, not a WTC11 property. Cutting HepG2 and K562 to WTC11's 4,612 training rows REVERSES the 6-mer lead in both and reproduces WTC11's numbers (K562's reduced 4-mer within 0.002 of WTC11's).
WTC11_BEST_ARM_IS_KMER4_NOT_KMER6.pooling_is_NOT_the_remedy: enlarging WTC11's training set by pooling cells hits the cross-cell fold conflict measured the same day; see wiki/human_fold_coordinate_leak_2026-11-23.json
